items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: The only other musician I had, the richer you know I had in my family was Richard M. Jones... They told me that he played the French horn. They told me that. I didn't see that.

ctx.x: Oh, he called him lying out. Yeah.
Yeah, but Richard, you listed everywhere as Richard L Jones. Yeah. Richard.
I was trying to think about what was in this neighborhood when we first came here.
